description: For every sound computably enumerable theorem-code predicate, some actual closed full second-order arithmetic validity has an unaccepted code.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderValidity.sound_effective_incomplete (P : ℕ → Prop) (hP : REPred P)
  (hS : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderValidity.Sound P) :
  ∃ φ,
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderValidity.FullValid φ ∧
      ¬P (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderValidity.formulaCode φ)
